summary: Amy French of The Good Life with Amy French presents a list of 12 sustainable New Year's resolutions, suggesting one goal per month as an easy way to live greener and move toward zero waste. The goals range from quitting disposable straws and planting something to making items instead of buying them, joining community action, learning skills, using the library and spending time in nature. The post also links to related resources and recipes on her site and several outside sustainability articles.
one_line: A list of 12 monthly sustainable New Year's resolutions, from quitting disposable straws to visiting the library and getting into nature.
key_facts: The post presents 12 sustainable New Year's resolutions, with the suggestion of one goal a month.
Goal 1 is Quit Disposable Straws, and the author's plan is to say 'Can I have that without a straw please?' every time she orders a drink.
Goal 2 is Plant or grow something New, and the author will plant oat seeds that the kids can watch grow over the summer break.
Goal 3 is Start A Zero Waste Challenge, using the War on Waste Challenge to reduce household waste and recycling.
Goal 4 is Remember Your Reusables, including reusable produce bags, cutlery and small containers.
Goal 5 is Make a Plastic-Free Product Swap, and the author's next big move is safety razors.
Goal 6 is Eat More Whole Foods, and the author suggests replacing crackers with carrots.
Goal 7 is MAKE Something You Would Normally Buy, and the author's latest project is eco-friendly glitter.
Goal 8 is Do Something in Your Community, and the author did a Soupahero Challenge, eating soup for an entire week to raise funds for homeless and at-risk people.
Goal 9 is Learn a New Skill, such as fixing a bike, learning to sew, or learning from a grandmother.
Goal 10 is Take on a Short Term Challenge, such as ride your bike to work day, Plastic Free July or Earth Hour.
Goal 11 is Visit Your Library, and the author says her library uses OneDrive and Libby for audio books.
Goal 12 is Get Into Nature, including visiting parks, botanic gardens, beaches or stargazing in the backyard.
The post is credited to Amy French and carries a 2018 copyright notice for The Good Life with Amy French, with 3,940 views shown.
